line.en: the saturday flea market on linke wienzeile runs 06:30 to 15:00. come early for the good things.
line.de: der samstagsflohmarkt an der linken wienzeile läuft von 06:30 bis 15:00. für die guten sachen früh kommen.
line.tr: linke wienzeile'daki cumartesi pazarı 06:30 ile 15:00 arası sürüyor. iyi parçalar için erken gel.

sparks.why: Naschmarkt flea market, every Saturday 06:30 to 15:00 on Linke Wienzeile, per ganz-wien.at and the City of Vienna market listing (recurring; not re-checked for 14 Nov in this run).
